prompt_md: A floor has parallel lines 10 cm apart. You drop a 10 cm needle so it lands at a random spot and a random angle. What is the chance it crosses a line?
prompt_short: Needle as long as the line spacing, dropped at random. Chance it crosses?
hint_md: Average the crossing chance over all angles.
explain_intuition_md: At angle θ to the lines, the needle spans 10·sin θ across them, so it crosses with chance sin θ. Averaged over all angles that comes to 2/π, about 64%. Guessing 50% assumes the span averages half the needle, but tilted needles still cover most of the gap.
